candidate_grammar.boundary: Every positive finite CBLX-017 description, execution, self-application, reduction, oracle record and registered theorem boundary.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete eight-axis CBLX-017 product before observation access.
candidate_grammar.unique_survivor: CBLX-017 uniquely retains self-verification-missing-distinction, complete self-application custody, root forcing, post-registry execution and no extra rule.

excluded_inputs: no axiom, imported computability theorem answer or target outcome selects the survivor
host absence and artifact counters are not admitted numerical-zero objects
no negative, irrational, imaginary, floating or completed-infinite proof scalar
no hidden transition, unregistered oracle, selected branch or stochastic cause
bounded exhaustion is not relabelled as an unrestricted negative result
no failed route retires an obligation or changes protected authority
statement: A sufficiently expressive sound generated proof process cannot close every statement about its own executions or certify its complete consistency from only its internal proof records; the missing self-distinction requires an explicitly stronger external record.
title: Incompleteness and internal consistency boundary
